elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: Vendor expressly “shall defend” Customer and its Affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: Vendor shall indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from any third-party claim and resulting losses.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Clause covers allegations that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Clause expressly covers Vendor's breach of Applicable Law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause expressly covers Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must give prompt written notice of the claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying party is given control of the defence.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Any Customer indemnity is expressly limited to third-party claims arising from Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims alleging that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion is imposed; the broader, unqualified IP indemnity is at least as protective as this permitted exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion is imposed; the broader, unqualified IP indemnity is at least as protective as this permitted exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion is imposed; the broader, unqualified IP indemnity is at least as protective as this permitted exclusion.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The operative indemnity contains no duty to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item; Section 9.3 merely contains a dangling reference to remedies in Section 20.5.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: No refund remedy is stated if procurement, modification, or replacement is unavailable.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No three-times-annual-fees cap appears; Section 21.3 instead classifies indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims.
